title: Retinal layer thickness PheWAS analyses
bodyHtml:
These links lead to supplemental visualizations that accompany the preprint:

Zekavat SM, et al.
Insights into human health from phenome- and genome-wide analyses of UK Biobank retinal optical coherence tomography phenotypes.
medRxiv preprint

Phenome-wide association analyses for retinal thicknesses

This study associated the thickness of different retinal layers with 1,866 incident ICD-based conditions and 88 quantitative traits and blood biomarkers. View the PheWAS plots:

  • Associations with time to retinal layer thicknesses
  • Associations of retinal layer thicknesses with incident phenotypes
  • Associations of retinal layer thicknesses with 88 quantitative traits and blood biomarkers
